method: Actual frozen cores, latest gameplay wrappers, native canvas, real installed pointer and keyboard listeners with capture/bubble event dispatch, actual arcadeInput and projectile collision. No physical Android/browser test.

results.name: Original mounted touch listeners reproduce firing with no aim point

detail.baseline: Touch fires but pointerdown/move never update aim

results.name: Real pointerdown/move hits an elevated MRG soldier manually in portrait/landscape/desktop and normal/calm modes
Deck touch uses the existing ground-plane ray without selecting or following an enemy
Joystick, canvas aim and fire button use independent non-primary touch pointers
Up, cancel, lost capture, outside release and capture-less browsers do not leave touch fire stuck
Pause, hidden page, actual terminal card and new board clear aim; old move cannot reactivate it
Existing canvas and remount/replacement bind once; stale canvas pointers cannot claim the new game
Mouse and keyboard behavior match the original; flight touches and invalid projections remain inactive
